description:
Connect ChatGPT to your Sociality.io workspace to analyze social media performance, competitor activity, and post-level results in one conversation. Ask ChatGPT to review account metrics, compare tracked competitors, summarize content performance, and find patterns across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

Use Sociality MCP to turn your social media data into practical reporting, benchmarking, and competitive research workflows. It helps marketers, agencies, and social media teams understand what changed, what performed well, and where to focus next.
